description: This file defines the Rotate3dAnimation class, which implements a 3D rotation animation on the Y axis for Android views. It manages rotation angles, center points, depth translation, and camera transformations to produce a rotating 3D effect.

classes.name: Rotate3dAnimation
classes.description: A custom animation class that executes a 3D rotation along the Y axis with depth translation on Android devices.

methods.name: Rotate3dAnimation
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the rotation angles, center point, depth, and direction of translation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Prepares the animation by creating and setting up the Camera object, called during animation setup.

methods.name: applyTransformation
methods.description: Calculates and applies the 3D rotation and translation to the transformation matrix based on the interpolated time.
